{"metadata":{"description":"Literature research for DeepSeek Harness — dblp + arXiv search, authoritative BibTeX, and full-text download.","id":"gh:1334819616","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-literature","slug":"SihanLv/dsh-literature","topics":["agent","autoresearch","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-bundle","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Literature research for DeepSeek Harness — dblp + arXiv search, authoritative BibTeX, and full-text "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"e research for DeepSeek Harness — dblp + arXiv search, authoritative BibTeX, and full-text download."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-literature — Literature Research for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**One query across dblp and arXiv.** The literature research capability for DeepSeek Harness: search"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" both sources, get one merged record per paper, the most authoritative BibTeX available, and full te"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"xt when it exists — without the model ever juggling two databases itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Install `@shlv/dsh-literature` into any profile (Web or Headless) and you get three model-facing too"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ls: `literature_search`, `literature_bibtex`, and `literature_fulltext`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"One command installs the whole family. To run from the dsh source repository (deepseek-harness) inst"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ead of the installed npm packages, set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and mount this repository's `literature.pa"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e installed npm packages, set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and mount this repository's `literature.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"(`/path/to/dsh-literature` is where you cloned this repository.)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Academic search splits across two databases with complementary coverage: **dblp** holds formal publi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"shed records (plus CoRR mirrors of arXiv `cs.*` preprints), while **arXiv** holds preprints that dbl"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"p syncs with a lag. Asking the model to query both and reconcile the answers wastes tokens and produ"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ces inconsistent citations. This seam (the shared service behind both sources) does the reconciliati"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"on once: dedupe, authoritative-source preference, and fallback are policy, not prompt engineering."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **One merged record per paper.** A dblp CoRR mirror, its formal published record, and the arXiv pr"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"eprint collapse into a single record — deduped by arXiv id (derived from the CoRR key when needed), "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"then publisher DOI, then normalized title.
- **Authoritative BibTeX, automatically.** Formal dblp en"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"try wins for published papers; a still-unpublished preprint gets the citation-correct arXiv `@misc`;"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" the dblp CoRR mirror is the last resort. No more citing a mirror artifact as the paper of record.
-"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" **Full text when it exists.** Acquires the arXiv LaTeX source tarball, then the HTML5 rendering, th"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"en the PDF — and for DOI-only or landing-page references, resolves the publisher PDF link through a "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"zero-tool subagent and extracts the body text.
- **Stable ids the model can reuse.** Every merged re"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"cord carries a stable plugin-generated `id` (`arxiv:…`, `dblp:…`, `doi:…`, `title:…`) the model can "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"pass straight back to `literature_bibtex` / `literature_fulltext`.
- **Precise title resolution.** T"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"itle queries pull the full dblp hit list plus a phrase-quoted arXiv search, then rerank by BM25 titl"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"e similarity — the paper you meant wins even when a newer same-topic paper would sort first.
- **Slo"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"w downloads never block a turn.** `literature_fulltext` runs as a background `ctx.jobs` job by defau"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"lt and returns a job id; `job_output` collects the result. Downloads that measure 25–60 s on publish"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"er sites don't stall the agent loop.
- **Hardened transport.** One HTTP layer for every request with"},{"id":"p14s16","text":" URL hygiene, no embedded credentials, same-origin redirects with at most one cross-origin hop, byte"},{"id":"p14s17","text":" caps, and cooperative deadlines.
- **Polite by default.** Both providers serialize through a rate l"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"imiter (arXiv at its documented 3 s interval, with exponential backoff on 429/503); one throttled so"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"urce never sinks a search."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The family mirrors the DeepSeek Harness capability-seam pattern — Service Definition / Provider / Co"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nsumer — behind one installable bundle:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Package | Role | Registers |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `@shlv/dsh-literature` (bundle) | **Install bundle**: the one package you `dsh plugin add`; depend"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"s on the four functional packages and ships the patch that mounts them | profile bundle layer |
| `@"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"shlv/dsh-literature-core` | **Service Definition** (`ctx.literature`): source registry, merge/dedupe"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"/fallback policy, record resolution, full-text strategy, shared HTTP transport, extraction helpers, "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"`LiteratureError` taxonomy | `ctx.literature` |
| `@shlv/dsh-literature-dblp` | **dblp source provid"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"er**: search API, record XML lookup, per-record BibTeX, CoRR↔arXiv key bridge | registers a source o"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"n `ctx.literature` |
| `@shlv/dsh-literature-arxiv` | **arXiv source provider**: Atom search, exact-"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"id lookup, BibTeX, full-text artifact download | registers a source on `ctx.literature` |
| `@shlv/d"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"sh-literature-tool` | **Consumer**: the three model-facing tools, their schemas, presentation, and t"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"he publisher-PDF-link subagent fallback | `ctx.tools` |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"You only ever install the bundle; the other four are its dependencies. The two sources share one sea"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"m because they evolve independently: the full-text machinery (tar, pdf.js) must not drag the dblp pr"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ovider, and a deployment that loads only one provider still gets a working search."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` (the tested baseline; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers declare `^0.2.0-rc."},{"id":"p21s2","text":"2`).
- Node.js `^22.19` or `>=24`.
- `literature_fulltext`'s background mode uses `@deepseek-ai/dsh-"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"jobs-local` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs`. The headless profile and Web's `standard` Agent preset"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" provide them. Custom compositions must mount the job registry and job-control tools in a scope serv"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ing the calling Agent.
- The publisher-PDF fallback needs the `subagents` service with a provider su"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"pporting `outputSchema` (default `spawn`). Without it, DOI-only and landing-page inputs report `LITE"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"RATURE_FULLTEXT_UNAVAILABLE`; search, BibTeX, and arXiv full text still work."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Publisher bot walls**: dl.acm.org returns 403 to non-browser clients, so ACM-DL DOIs fail at the"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" landing-page fetch.
- **The arXiv HTML5 rendering exists only for a subset of papers**; the provide"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"r returns `null` for the other kinds so the seam falls back.
- **The CoRR bridge covers only arXiv `"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"cs.*` categories**; non-CS papers rely on DOI or title matching.
- **LaTeX → prose is lossy**: the s"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ource-tarball summary strips commands and comments, not a rendered document.
- **SSRF / private-netw"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ork blocking is deferred**, matching the web fetch provider: http(s) only, no embedded credentials, "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"same-origin redirects with at most one cross-origin hop."}],"truncated":true}
